name: Charred Outpost
summary: The Charred Outpost is a scorched Scarlet Crusade encampment situated in the Western Plaguelands between Felstone Field and Dalson's Farm. Established as a frontline station amidst the blighted countryside, the post houses zealots fighting to purge the undead from Lordaeron.

sections.title: A Scorched Bulwark
sections.body: Positioned squarely between the corrupted blighted farmlands of Felstone Field and Dalson's Farm, the Charred Outpost serves as a grim Scarlet Crusade foothold. The zealots stationed here—including experienced hunters, battle medics, and invokers—strive to stem the unending tide of Scourge crawling out from the surrounding ruins. Despite the heavy scorch marks and ruined structures that earned the site its moniker, the Crusade tenaciously maintains its presence, treating any uninvited traveler with immediate and lethal hostility.

faq.answer: It is an active Scarlet Crusade encampment nestled between Felstone Field and Dalson's Farm in the Western Plaguelands, acting as an armed outpost against the area's rampant undead.
The outpost is manned by zealots of the Scarlet Crusade, including hunters, medics, and invokers dedicated to scouring the Plaguelands of both Scourge and Forsaken.

faq.q: Why is the camp charred and ruined?
faq.answer: The encampment sits on the dangerous frontline of the Plaguelands, where clashes against undead horrors and the scorched-earth tactics favored by the Crusade have left the outpost blackened and battered.

faq.q: Are the Crusaders here friendly to Alliance visitors?
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Crusade has descended into rabid fanaticism, suspecting all outsiders of carrying the taint of undeath. They will violently attack Alliance and Horde travelers on sight.

angles.text: The zealots at the Charred Outpost make no distinction between the mindless Scourge and free-willed Forsaken, executing any undead they capture with righteous fervor.
The camp offers a sobering reminder of how the noble calling of the Silver Hand has been corrupted into blind zealotry by the Scarlet Crusade.
